title: BetterMiniStructures
body:
Upgrade your world with: Better Mini Structures.
This mod adds cool, new and varied mini structures to give your world a more lively look.

🎨 Style:

The structures are vanilla-like and use features already found in Minecraft, ensuring they blend naturally into your world.

🎉 Future Updates:

We're constantly working on adding more structures to the mod. Stay tuned for future updates.
